const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();

function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}

 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}

function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}

}

function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}

 else if(k==='perfect'){beep(980,.07,.05,'triangle',1320);setTimeout(()=>beep(1360,.06,.03),50)}

 else if(k==='thump'){beep(92,.12,.09,'sine',55);setTimeout(()=>beep(245,.06,.035,'triangle',170),18)}
 else if(k==='water')beep(1180,.045,.018,'sine',820);
 else if(k==='tap')beep(320,.02,.015,'square',450);
}

 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

let mem=null,audioCtx=null;
function localDateKey(){
 const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}
function load(){try{const x=localStorage.getItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked');return x?JSON.parse(x):null}catch(e){return mem}}
function save(){mem=state;try{localStorage.setItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked',JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}}
let state=load()||{unlock:{},best:{},coins:0,todayEarned:0,todayScore:0,scoreDate:localDateKey(),pdRecord:0,coinDate:localDateKey(),ranking:[],todaySubmittedBest:0,rankRegisteredBest:11,ownedSkins:['default'],selectedSkin:'default'};
if(!state.best||typeof state.best!=='object')state.best={};
if(!Array.isArray(state.ranking))state.ranking=[];
if(!Array.isArray(state.ownedSkins))state.ownedSkins=['default'];
if(!state.gpsCalibration)state.gpsCalibration={};
if(!state.gpsUnlocked)state.gpsUnlocked={};
if(!state.qrUnlocked)state.qrUnlocked={};
if(!state.ownedSkins.includes('default'))state.ownedSkins.unshift('default');
if(!state.selectedSkin||!state.ownedSkins.includes(state.selectedSkin))state.selectedSkin='default';
if(state.todayEarned==null)state.todayEarned=0;
if(state.todayScore==null)state.todayScore=0;
if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
if(state.todaySubmittedBest==null)state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
if(state.rankRegisteredBest==null){
 state.rankRegisteredBest=Number.isFinite(state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank)?state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank:11;
}
if(state.scoreDate!==localDateKey()){
 state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
}
if(!state.coinDate)state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(state.coinDate!==localDateKey())state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED)GAMES.forEach(g=>state.unlock[g.code]=true);

function ensureDailyScoreDate(){
 const today=localDateKey();
 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

const DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED=[
 {initials:'중앙시장',score:1000000,date:'기준',ts:1,seed:true},
 {initials:'오소',score:500000,date:'기준',ts:2,seed:true},
 {initials:'또오소',score:300000,date:'기준',ts:3,seed:true},
 {initials:'다시오소',score:100000,date:'기준',ts:4,seed:true},
 {initials:'매일오소',score:80000,date:'기준',ts:5,seed:true},
 {initials:'잘가소',score:50000,date:'기준',ts:6,seed:true},
 {initials:'반갑소',score:30000,date:'기준',ts:7,seed:true},
 {initials:'어서오소',score:20000,date:'기준',ts:8,seed:true},
 {initials:'잘하소',score:15000,date:'기준',ts:9,seed:true},
 {initials:'힘내소',score:10000,date:'기준',ts:10,seed:true}
];
const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}
ensureDefaultRanking();
ensureRankRegistrationState();

ensureDefaultRanking();

function game(c){return GAMES.find(g=>g.code===c)}
function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}
let pendingBrowserBuzz=null,hapticsPrimed=false;
function buzz(v=32){
 const h=normalizeBuzz(v);
 if(nativeBuzz(h)){pendingBrowserBuzz=null;return true}
 const ok=browserBuzz(h);pendingBrowserBuzz=ok?null:h;return ok
}
// content:// / file://에서는 네이티브 브리지가 없으므로 실제 사용자 터치에서 대기 중인 진동을 다시 시도한다.
addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
 if(pendingBrowserBuzz){const h=pendingBrowserBuzz;pendingBrowserBuzz=null;browserBuzz(h);return}
 if(!hapticsPrimed){hapticsPrimed=true;browserBuzz(32)}
},{capture:true,passive:true});
function bombBuzz(){
 const h=[180,45,260,50,360];
 try{const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;if(b&&typeof b.bomb==='function'&&Number(b.bomb())===1)return true}catch(e){}
 return browserBuzz(h)
}
function audio(){try{return audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){return null}}
function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}

 if(k==='good')beep(730,.05,.035,'sine',900);

 else if(k==='coin')beep(1120,.05,.034,'square',1460);
 else if(k==='clear'){beep(620,.15,.05,'triangle',1240);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.18,.04,'sine',1560),85)}
 else if(k==='thump'){beep(92,.12,.09,'sine',55);setTimeout(()=>beep(245,.06,.035,'triangle',170),18)}
 else if(k==='water')beep(1180,.045,.018,'sine',820);
 else if(k==='tap')beep(320,.02,.015,'square',450);
}

n bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));

}

 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

const DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED=[
 {initials:'중앙시장',score:1000000,date:'기준',ts:1,seed:true},
 {initials:'오소',score:500000,date:'기준',ts:2,seed:true},
 {initials:'또오소',score:300000,date:'기준',ts:3,seed:true},
 {initials:'다시오소',score:100000,date:'기준',ts:4,seed:true},
 {initials:'매일오소',score:80000,date:'기준',ts:5,seed:true},
 {initials:'잘가소',score:50000,date:'기준',ts:6,seed:true},
 {initials:'반갑소',score:30000,date:'기준',ts:7,seed:true},
 {initials:'어서오소',score:20000,date:'기준',ts:8,seed:true},
 {initials:'잘하소',score:15000,date:'기준',ts:9,seed:true},
 {initials:'힘내소',score:10000,date:'기준',ts:10,seed:true}
];
const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}
ensureDefaultRanking();
ensureRankRegistrationState();

ensureDefaultRanking();
let selected=null,cleanup=null;

function game(c){return GAMES.find(g=>g.code===c)}
function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}
let pendingBrowserBuzz=null,hapticsPrimed=false;
function buzz(v=32){
 const h=normalizeBuzz(v);
 if(nativeBuzz(h)){pendingBrowserBuzz=null;return true}
 const ok=browserBuzz(h);pendingBrowserBuzz=ok?null:h;return ok
}
// content:// / file://에서는 네이티브 브리지가 없으므로 실제 사용자 터치에서 대기 중인 진동을 다시 시도한다.
addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
 if(pendingBrowserBuzz){const h=pendingBrowserBuzz;pendingBrowserBuzz=null;browserBuzz(h);return}
 if(!hapticsPrimed){hapticsPrimed=true;browserBuzz(32)}
},{capture:true,passive:true});
function bombBuzz(){
 const h=[180,45,260,50,360];
 try{const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;if(b&&typeof b.bomb==='function'&&Number(b.bomb())===1)return true}catch(e){}
 return browserBuzz(h)
}
function audio(){try{return audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){return null}}
function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}
function tone(k){
 if(k==='good')beep(730,.05,.035,'sine',900);
 else if(k==='perfect'){beep(980,.07,.05,'triangle',1320);setTimeout(()=>beep(1360,.06,.03),50)}
 else if(k==='bad')beep(165,.1,.055,'sawtooth',90);
 else if(k==='coin')beep(1120,.05,.034,'square',1460);
 else if(k==='clear'){beep(620,.15,.05,'triangle',1240);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.18,.04,'sine',1560),85)}
 else if(k==='thump'){beep(92,.12,.09,'sine',55);setTimeout(()=>beep(245,.06,.035,'triangle',170),18)}
 else if(k==='water')beep(1180,.045,.018,'sine',820);
 else if(k==='tap')beep(320,.02,.015,'square',450);
}

}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function currentSkin(){return OSO_SKINS.find(x=>x.id===state.selectedSkin)||OSO_SKINS[0]}
function currentOsoSrc(){return currentSkin().src}
const BASE_GAME_CODES=['basket','fish','stack','run','slice','tteok','powerduck'];
const BONUS_GAME_CODES=['spacefighter','racing','fantasy'];
function ensureSpacefighterUnlock(){
 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;
 if(BASE_GAME_CODES.every(c=>state.unlock&&state.unlock[c])){
  state.unlock.spacefighter=true;save();return true
 }
 return false
}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

let mem=null,audioCtx=null;
function localDateKey(){
 const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}
function load(){try{const x=localStorage.getItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked');return x?JSON.parse(x):null}catch(e){return mem}}
function save(){mem=state;try{localStorage.setItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked',JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}}
let state=load()||{unlock:{},best:{},coins:0,todayEarned:0,todayScore:0,scoreDate:localDateKey(),pdRecord:0,coinDate:localDateKey(),ranking:[],todaySubmittedBest:0,rankRegisteredBest:11,ownedSkins:['default'],selectedSkin:'default'};
if(!state.best||typeof state.best!=='object')state.best={};
if(!Array.isArray(state.ranking))state.ranking=[];
if(!Array.isArray(state.ownedSkins))state.ownedSkins=['default'];
if(!state.gpsCalibration)state.gpsCalibration={};
if(!state.gpsUnlocked)state.gpsUnlocked={};
if(!state.qrUnlocked)state.qrUnlocked={};
if(!state.ownedSkins.includes('default'))state.ownedSkins.unshift('default');
if(!state.selectedSkin||!state.ownedSkins.includes(state.selectedSkin))state.selectedSkin='default';
if(state.todayEarned==null)state.todayEarned=0;
if(state.todayScore==null)state.todayScore=0;
if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
if(state.todaySubmittedBest==null)state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
if(state.rankRegisteredBest==null){
 state.rankRegisteredBest=Number.isFinite(state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank)?state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank:11;
}
if(state.scoreDate!==localDateKey()){
 state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
}
if(!state.coinDate)state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(state.coinDate!==localDateKey())state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED)GAMES.forEach(g=>state.unlock[g.code]=true);

function ensureDailyScoreDate(){
 const today=localDateKey();
 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}

 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}

function game(c){return GAMES.find(g=>g.code===c)}
function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}
let pendingBrowserBuzz=null,hapticsPrimed=false;
function buzz(v=32){
 const h=normalizeBuzz(v);
 if(nativeBuzz(h)){pendingBrowserBuzz=null;return true}
 const ok=browserBuzz(h);pendingBrowserBuzz=ok?null:h;return ok
}
// content:// / file://에서는 네이티브 브리지가 없으므로 실제 사용자 터치에서 대기 중인 진동을 다시 시도한다.
addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
 if(pendingBrowserBuzz){const h=pendingBrowserBuzz;pendingBrowserBuzz=null;browserBuzz(h);return}
 if(!hapticsPrimed){hapticsPrimed=true;browserBuzz(32)}
},{capture:true,passive:true});
function bombBuzz(){
 const h=[180,45,260,50,360];
 try{const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;if(b&&typeof b.bomb==='function'&&Number(b.bomb())===1)return true}catch(e){}
 return browserBuzz(h)
}
function audio(){try{return audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){return null}}
function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}
function tone(k){
 if(k==='good')beep(730,.05,.035,'sine',900);
 else if(k==='perfect'){beep(980,.07,.05,'triangle',1320);setTimeout(()=>beep(1360,.06,.03),50)}
 else if(k==='bad')beep(165,.1,.055,'sawtooth',90);
 else if(k==='coin')beep(1120,.05,.034,'square',1460);
 else if(k==='clear'){beep(620,.15,.05,'triangle',1240);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.18,.04,'sine',1560),85)}
 else if(k==='thump'){beep(92,.12,.09,'sine',55);setTimeout(()=>beep(245,.06,.035,'triangle',170),18)}
 else if(k==='water')beep(1180,.045,.018,'sine',820);
 else if(k==='tap')beep(320,.02,.015,'square',450);
}

function saveCalPoint(kind){
 if(!lastGps){$('#calOutput').textContent='먼저 GPS 위치 확인을 시작하소.';return}
 const code=currentCalibrationSelection();if(!code)return;
 const old=(state.gpsCalibration||{})[code]||{};
 if(kind==='center'){
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'circle',lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng,radius:45,near:160,source:'field-calibration'}
 }else{
  let a=old.a||null,b=old.b||null;if(kind==='a')a={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};else b={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'corridor',a,b,radius:24,near:150,source:'field-calibration'};
  if(!a||!b){state.gpsCalibration[code].pending=true}
  else delete state.gpsCalibration[code].pending
 }
 save();
 $('#calOutput').textContent=JSON.stringify(state.gpsCalibration,null,2);
 renderGpsLocations(lastGps)
}

const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();
function fxText(x,y,text,color='#f39a11'){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),e=document.createElement('div');e.className='fxText';e.textContent=text;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.color=color;s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),700)}
function particles(x,y,emoji='✨',count=6){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect();if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)count=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(count*.45));for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='particle';e.textContent=emoji;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--dy',(-35-Math.random()*85)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*300-150)+'deg');s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),760)}}

 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();
function fxText(x,y,text,color='#f39a11'){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),e=document.createElement('div');e.className='fxText';e.textContent=text;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.color=color;s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),700)}
function particles(x,y,emoji='✨',count=6){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect();if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)count=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(count*.45));for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='particle';e.textContent=emoji;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--dy',(-35-Math.random()*85)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*300-150)+'deg');s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),760)}}

function showComboBurst(text,count=2,kind='combo'){
 const s=$('#stage');if(!s)return;
 $$('.comboBurstFX').forEach(e=>e.remove());
 const tier=count>=10?3:count>=5?2:1,e=document.createElement('div');
 e.className=`comboBurstFX tier${tier} ${kind||''}`;e.textContent=text;s.appendChild(e);
 const r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2,y=r.top+r.height*.19;
 particles(x,y,count>=10?'🔥':count>=5?'⭐':'✨',count>=10?18:count>=5?13:9);
 const p=520+Math.min(12,count)*28;beep(p,.055,.020,'square',p*1.20);setTimeout(()=>beep(p*1.25,.065,.016,'triangle',p*1.33),58);
 buzz(count>=10?[18,6,28,6,42]:count>=5?[13,5,22]:8);
 setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),1120)
}

function gpsZones(){
 const z={...GPS_DEFAULTS};
 const cal=state.gpsCalibration||{};
 Object.keys(cal).forEach(k=>{if(cal[k])z[k]=cal[k]});
 return z
}
function rad(d){return d*Math.PI/180}
function metersBetween(a,b){
 const R=6371000,dLat=rad(b.lat-a.lat),dLon=rad(b.lng-a.lng),la1=rad(a.lat),la2=rad(b.lat);
 const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
 return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)))
}
function pointSegmentDistanceM(p,a,b){
 const lat0=rad((a.lat+b.lat+p.lat)/3),mx=111320*Math.cos(lat0),my=110540;
 const ax=a.lng*mx,ay=a.lat*my,bx=b.lng*mx,by=b.lat*my,px=p.lng*mx,py=p.lat*my;
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 if(!l2)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
 let t=((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy))
}
function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}

 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';

 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}

 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}

function audio(){try{return audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){return null}}
function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);

}

}

function currentSkin(){return OSO_SKINS.find(x=>x.id===state.selectedSkin)||OSO_SKINS[0]}
function currentOsoSrc(){return currentSkin().src}
const BASE_GAME_CODES=['basket','fish','stack','run','slice','tteok','powerduck'];
const BONUS_GAME_CODES=['spacefighter','racing','fantasy'];
function ensureSpacefighterUnlock(){
 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;
 if(BASE_GAME_CODES.every(c=>state.unlock&&state.unlock[c])){
  state.unlock.spacefighter=true;save();return true
 }
 return false
}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

let mem=null,audioCtx=null;
function localDateKey(){
 const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}
function load(){try{const x=localStorage.getItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked');return x?JSON.parse(x):null}catch(e){return mem}}
function save(){mem=state;try{localStorage.setItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked',JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}}
let state=load()||{unlock:{},best:{},coins:0,todayEarned:0,todayScore:0,scoreDate:localDateKey(),pdRecord:0,coinDate:localDateKey(),ranking:[],todaySubmittedBest:0,rankRegisteredBest:11,ownedSkins:['default'],selectedSkin:'default'};
if(!state.best||typeof state.best!=='object')state.best={};
if(!Array.isArray(state.ranking))state.ranking=[];
if(!Array.isArray(state.ownedSkins))state.ownedSkins=['default'];
if(!state.gpsCalibration)state.gpsCalibration={};
if(!state.gpsUnlocked)state.gpsUnlocked={};
if(!state.qrUnlocked)state.qrUnlocked={};
if(!state.ownedSkins.includes('default'))state.ownedSkins.unshift('default');
if(!state.selectedSkin||!state.ownedSkins.includes(state.selectedSkin))state.selectedSkin='default';
if(state.todayEarned==null)state.todayEarned=0;
if(state.todayScore==null)state.todayScore=0;
if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
if(state.todaySubmittedBest==null)state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
if(state.rankRegisteredBest==null){
 state.rankRegisteredBest=Number.isFinite(state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank)?state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank:11;
}
if(state.scoreDate!==localDateKey()){
 state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
}
if(!state.coinDate)state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(state.coinDate!==localDateKey())state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED)GAMES.forEach(g=>state.unlock[g.code]=true);

function ensureDailyScoreDate(){
 const today=localDateKey();
 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

const DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED=[
 {initials:'중앙시장',score:1000000,date:'기준',ts:1,seed:true},
 {initials:'오소',score:500000,date:'기준',ts:2,seed:true},
 {initials:'또오소',score:300000,date:'기준',ts:3,seed:true},
 {initials:'다시오소',score:100000,date:'기준',ts:4,seed:true},
 {initials:'매일오소',score:80000,date:'기준',ts:5,seed:true},
 {initials:'잘가소',score:50000,date:'기준',ts:6,seed:true},
 {initials:'반갑소',score:30000,date:'기준',ts:7,seed:true},
 {initials:'어서오소',score:20000,date:'기준',ts:8,seed:true},
 {initials:'잘하소',score:15000,date:'기준',ts:9,seed:true},
 {initials:'힘내소',score:10000,date:'기준',ts:10,seed:true}
];
const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}
ensureDefaultRanking();
ensureRankRegistrationState();

ensureDefaultRanking();

function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}
let pendingBrowserBuzz=null,hapticsPrimed=false;
function buzz(v=32){
 const h=normalizeBuzz(v);
 if(nativeBuzz(h)){pendingBrowserBuzz=null;return true}
 const ok=browserBuzz(h);pendingBrowserBuzz=ok?null:h;return ok
}

},{capture:true,passive:true});

 return browserBuzz(h)
}

const BASE_GAME_CODES=['basket','fish','stack','run','slice','tteok','powerduck'];
const BONUS_GAME_CODES=['spacefighter','racing','fantasy'];
function ensureSpacefighterUnlock(){
 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;
 if(BASE_GAME_CODES.every(c=>state.unlock&&state.unlock[c])){
  state.unlock.spacefighter=true;save();return true
 }
 return false
}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

function localDateKey(){
 const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}

let state=load()||{unlock:{},best:{},coins:0,todayEarned:0,todayScore:0,scoreDate:localDateKey(),pdRecord:0,coinDate:localDateKey(),ranking:[],todaySubmittedBest:0,rankRegisteredBest:11,ownedSkins:['default'],selectedSkin:'default'};
if(!state.best||typeof state.best!=='object')state.best={};
if(!Array.isArray(state.ranking))state.ranking=[];
if(!Array.isArray(state.ownedSkins))state.ownedSkins=['default'];
if(!state.gpsCalibration)state.gpsCalibration={};
if(!state.gpsUnlocked)state.gpsUnlocked={};
if(!state.qrUnlocked)state.qrUnlocked={};
if(!state.ownedSkins.includes('default'))state.ownedSkins.unshift('default');

if(state.todayEarned==null)state.todayEarned=0;
if(state.todayScore==null)state.todayScore=0;
if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
if(state.todaySubmittedBest==null)state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
if(state.rankRegisteredBest==null){
 state.rankRegisteredBest=Number.isFinite(state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank)?state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank:11;
}
if(state.scoreDate!==localDateKey()){
 state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
}

if(state.coinDate!==localDateKey())state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED)GAMES.forEach(g=>state.unlock[g.code]=true);

 const today=localDateKey();
 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

 {initials:'중앙시장',score:1000000,date:'기준',ts:1,seed:true},
 {initials:'오소',score:500000,date:'기준',ts:2,seed:true},

 {initials:'힘내소',score:10000,date:'기준',ts:10,seed:true}
];
const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}
ensureDefaultRanking();
ensureRankRegistrationState();

function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}
let pendingBrowserBuzz=null,hapticsPrimed=false;
function buzz(v=32){
 const h=normalizeBuzz(v);
 if(nativeBuzz(h)){pendingBrowserBuzz=null;return true}
 const ok=browserBuzz(h);pendingBrowserBuzz=ok?null:h;return ok
}
// content:// / file://에서는 네이티브 브리지가 없으므로 실제 사용자 터치에서 대기 중인 진동을 다시 시도한다.
addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
 if(pendingBrowserBuzz){const h=pendingBrowserBuzz;pendingBrowserBuzz=null;browserBuzz(h);return}
 if(!hapticsPrimed){hapticsPrimed=true;browserBuzz(32)}
},{capture:true,passive:true});
function bombBuzz(){
 const h=[180,45,260,50,360];
 try{const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;if(b&&typeof b.bomb==='function'&&Number(b.bomb())===1)return true}catch(e){}
 return browserBuzz(h)
}
function audio(){try{return audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){return null}}
function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}
function tone(k){
 if(k==='good')beep(730,.05,.035,'sine',900);
 else if(k==='perfect'){beep(980,.07,.05,'triangle',1320);setTimeout(()=>beep(1360,.06,.03),50)}
 else if(k==='bad')beep(165,.1,.055,'sawtooth',90);
 else if(k==='coin')beep(1120,.05,.034,'square',1460);
 else if(k==='clear'){beep(620,.15,.05,'triangle',1240);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.18,.04,'sine',1560),85)}
 else if(k==='thump'){beep(92,.12,.09,'sine',55);setTimeout(()=>beep(245,.06,.035,'triangle',170),18)}
 else if(k==='water')beep(1180,.045,.018,'sine',820);
 else if(k==='tap')beep(320,.02,.015,'square',450);
}

const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();

const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();

 function rrPath(x,y,w,h,r){r=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);ctx.closePath()}

 function addParticle(x,y,color='#ffd75d',count=10,speed=150,size=3,life=.55){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=speed*(.35+Math.random()*.75);
   particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:size*(.55+Math.random()*.9),life,max:life,color,rot:Math.random()*6.28,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*8})
  }
 }
 function addRing(x,y,color='#fff',max=64,life=.48,width=4){
  rings.push({x,y,r:3,max,life,maxLife:life,color,width})
 }
 function explode(x,y,big=false){
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ffb12d':'#ffd868',big?34:13,big?250:155,big?6:3,big?.9:.55);
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ff496c':'#ff865c',big?26:8,big?210:130,big?5:2.5,big?.8:.45);
  addParticle(x,y,'#ffffff',big?18:5,big?180:110,big?4:2,big?.55:.3);
  addRing(x,y,big?'#fff19b':'#fff7c9',big?100:42,big?.7:.35,big?7:3);
  screenShake=Math.max(screenShake,big?10:2.4);
  if(big)bombBuzz();else buzz(12)
 }
 function bossExplosion(x,y){
  screenShake=17;bombBuzz();tone('clear');
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
   setTimeout(()=>{
    const ox=x+(Math.random()-.5)*120,oy=y+(Math.random()-.5)*90;
    explode(ox,oy,true);
    addRing(x,y,i%2?'#ff73c7':'#75eaff',90+i*28,.8,6);
    beep(90+i*24,.09,.05,'sawtooth',45)
   },i*115)
  }
  setTimeout(()=>bombBuzz(),420);

 function addParticle(x,y,color='#ffd75d',count=10,speed=150,size=3,life=.55){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=speed*(.35+Math.random()*.75);
   particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:size*(.55+Math.random()*.9),life,max:life,color,rot:Math.random()*6.28,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*8})
  }
 }
 function addRing(x,y,color='#fff',max=64,life=.48,width=4){
  rings.push({x,y,r:3,max,life,maxLife:life,color,width})
 }
 function explode(x,y,big=false){
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ffb12d':'#ffd868',big?34:13,big?250:155,big?6:3,big?.9:.55);
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ff496c':'#ff865c',big?26:8,big?210:130,big?5:2.5,big?.8:.45);
  addParticle(x,y,'#ffffff',big?18:5,big?180:110,big?4:2,big?.55:.3);
  addRing(x,y,big?'#fff19b':'#fff7c9',big?100:42,big?.7:.35,big?7:3);
  screenShake=Math.max(screenShake,big?10:2.4);
  if(big)bombBuzz();else buzz(12)
 }
 function bossExplosion(x,y){
  screenShake=17;bombBuzz();tone('clear');
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
   setTimeout(()=>{
    const ox=x+(Math.random()-.5)*120,oy=y+(Math.random()-.5)*90;
    explode(ox,oy,true);
    addRing(x,y,i%2?'#ff73c7':'#75eaff',90+i*28,.8,6);
    beep(90+i*24,.09,.05,'sawtooth',45)
   },i*115)
  }
  setTimeout(()=>bombBuzz(),420);
  setTimeout(()=>buzz([50,25,90,25,150]),820)
 }

    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(28,-22);ctx.lineTo(94,-70);ctx.lineTo(72,6);ctx.lineTo(112,34);ctx.lineTo(42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ff315d';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=18;

   drawEmoji(boss.icon,boss.x,boss.y,(92+stageNo*9)*(finalForm?1.28:1));

  }

 let speed=0,distance=0,score=0,playerX=0,targetX=0,boost=0,boostUntil=0,lastSection=0,shake=0;
 let accelHeld=false,accelPointer=null,brakeHeld=false,brakePointer=null,driftHeld=false,driftPointer=null,steering=false,steerDir=0,steerPointer=null;

 /* 표시 속도는 현실적인 220/260 km/h.

20)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wall'){
   const gap=W*(.20+(bossPhase%4)*.20);
   for(let xx=20;xx<W;xx+=48)if(Math.abs(xx-gap)>88)addBullet(xx,y,0,132,4.5,'#ffd15a');
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,145)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wave'){
   for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+k*.21;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*142,Math.sin(a)*142,4.5,k%2?'#6ee8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }
 function spawnBoss(){
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];
  const baseHp=46+stageNo*17;
  const powerScale=(power-1)*10;
  const optionScale=options*8;
  const hp=baseHp+powerScale+optionScale;
  const r=48+stageNo*4;
  const bossY=185;
  boss={x:W*.5,y:bossY,r,hp,max:hp,t:0,icon:st.boss,name:st.bossName,form:1,morphing:false};
  bullets=[];$('#sfBossBar').classList.add('show');
  const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent='BOSS 100%';
  banner('WARNING!',`${st.bossName} · 강화도 ${power+options}`);
  tone('bad');buzz([35,20,55]);addRing(W*.5,bossY,'#ffef76',120,.8,6)
 }

 function firePattern(originX,originY,fromClone=false){
  const speed=-560;
  const add=(dx,vx=0,scale=1)=>shots.push({x:originX+dx,y:originY-24,vx,vy:speed,r:7*scale,clone:fromClone});
  if(fromClone){add(0,0,.72);return}
  if(power===1)add(0);
  else if(power===2){add(-8);add(8)}
  else if(power===3){add(-12);add(0);add(12)}
  else if(power===4){add(-14);add(0);add(14);add(-8,-95,.85);add(8,95,.85)}
  else{add(-18);add(-9);add(0);add(9);add(18);add(-11,-125,.82);add(11,125,.82)}
 }
 function firePlayer(ts){
  const delay=Math.max(70,98-power*5);
  if(ts-lastShot<delay)return;lastShot=ts;
  firePattern(player.x,player.y,false);
  clonePositions().forEach(c=>firePattern(c.x,c.y,true));
  if(group==='oso')beep(360,.016,.006,'square',530);else beep(900,.016,.0045,'sine',1280)
 }

 function hitPlayer(){
  if(player.inv>0||!alive)return;
  player.lives--;player.inv=1300;bombBuzz();screenShake=8;bullets.splice(0,Math.min(bullets.length,15));
  updateHud();
  if(player.lives<=0){
   alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();stopBGM();
   finish('spacefighter',Math.floor(score),beginSpacefighter,false,bonusCoins)
  }
 }

 // 초필살기: 화면 전체 광선/확산링/입자 + 적탄 제거 + 졸개 전멸 + 보스 대미지
 function useSuper(){
  if(gauge<100||!alive)return;
  gauge=0;bullets=[];
  const now=performance.now();
  superFx={start:now,end:now+(isKf21?1750:1350),kind:isKf21?'kf21':(group==='oso'?'cargo':'pearl')};
  let bonus=0;
  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   if(e.hp>0){bonus+=120*stageNo;explode(e.x,e.y,true);e.hp=0}
  });
  if(boss&&!boss.morphing){boss.hp-=18+stageNo*5;addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#fff269',150,.9,8)}
  score+=bonus;

  for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=80+Math.random()*340;
   particles.push({
    x:player.x,y:player.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,
    r:2+Math.random()*6,life:.65+Math.random()*.8,max:1.4,
    color:i%3===0?'#ffffff':i%3===1?'#72ecff':'#ff75ca',
    rot:a,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*12
   })
  }
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addRing(player.x,player.y,i%2?'#7cf2ff':'#ffe665',80+i*55,1.1,8-i*.7);

  const f=$('#sfFlash');f.classList.remove('on');void f.offsetWidth;f.classList.add('on');
  bombBuzz();setTimeout(()=>buzz([40,20,70,20,110]),330);setTimeout(()=>buzz([30,15,50]),720);
  beep(180,.35,.07,'sawtooth',850);setTimeout(()=>beep(880,.38,.06,'triangle',1680),120);
  banner('초필살기 MAX!',superName);screenShake=14;updateHud()
 }
 superBtn.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();useSuper()};

 function pointerPos(e){
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  player.x=clamp(e.clientX-r.left,22,W-22);
  player.y=clamp(e.clientY-r.top,205,H-38)
 }
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{drag=true;canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(drag)pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=false);
 canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>drag=false);

 function drawBackground(st,dt){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,st.bg[0]);g.addColorStop(1,st.bg[1]);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  stars.forEach(q=>{
   q.y+=dt*q.p*(.22+stageNo*.05);if(q.y>1)q.y-=1;q.tw+=dt*4;
   ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.22+q.p*.52+Math.sin(q.tw)*.1})`;
   ctx.fillRect(q.x*W,q.y*H,q.s,q.s*2.4)
  });

  const t=performance.now();
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.34;
  if(stageNo===1){
   for(let y=(t*.055)%120-120;y<H;y+=120){
    ctx.fillStyle='#7e4225';ctx.fillRect(0,y,W,16);
    for(let x=10;x<W;x+=72){
     ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a9';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,34);
     ctx.fillStyle='#d9534f';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,5)
    }
   }
  }else if(stageNo===2){
   ctx.fillStyle='#d4c19d';
   for(let y=(t*.04)%64-64;y<H;y+=64)for(let x=-25;x<W;x+=62){
    ctx.fillRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#7b654d';ctx.strokeRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26)
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#8a5e42';ctx.fillRect(W*.12,0,12,H);ctx.fillRect(W*.82,0,12,H)
  }else if(stageNo===3){
   ctx.strokeStyle='#bdf9ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;
   for(let y=(t*.09)%55-55;y<H;y+=55){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14){
     let yy=y+Math.sin(x*.05+t*.0023)*8;
     x?ctx.lineTo(x,yy):ctx.moveTo(x,yy)
    }
    ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff55';
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    let x=(i*67+t*.03)%W,y=(i*91+t*.08)%H;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,3+i%3,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
  }else if(stageNo===4){
   const eg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H+90,20,W*.5,H+90,W*.72);
   eg.addColorStop(0,'#7ee7ff');eg.addColorStop(.62,'#2872dc');eg.addColorStop(1,'#0b214c');
   ctx.fillStyle=eg;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*.5,H+105,W*.72,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
   ctx.fillStyle='#56c96d';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(W*.38,H-6,58,16,-.2,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }else{
   const ng=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.25,H*.3,5,W*.25,H*.3,W*.5);
   ng.addColorStop(0,'#8d46cbbb');ng.addColorStop(.45,'#36124f66');ng.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
   ctx.fillStyle=ng;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#8f39af';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   for(let y=(t*.095)%90-90;y<H;y+=90){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y+44);ctx.stroke()
   }
  }
  ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawEmoji(icon,x,y,size){
  ctx.save();ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.shadowColor='#0008';ctx.shadowBlur=6;ctx.font=`${size}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(icon,x,y);ctx.restore()
 }
 function drawItem(it,ts){
  const bob=Math.sin(ts*.006+it.phase)*5;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(it.x,it.y+bob);
  if(it.type==='C'){
   ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.shadowColor='#ffd83d';ctx.fillStyle='#ffd83d';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff2a0';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
   ctx.font='23px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText('🪙',0,1);ctx.restore();return
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=16;ctx.shadowColor=it.type==='P'?'#ffdf4f':'#d486ff';
  ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#ffe457':'#b96cff';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#654117':'#fff';
  ctx.font='1000 17px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(it.type,0,1);ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawSuper(ts){
  if(!superFx||ts>superFx.end){superFx=null;return}
  const p=clamp((ts-superFx.start)/(superFx.end-superFx.start),0,1),fade=1-p;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.14*fade})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
   ctx.rotate(Math.PI*2/18);
   const
===== drawImage(playerImg COUNT=4 =====
--- 1 @ 1354179 ---
moji","Apple Color Emoji",sans-serif';
   ctx.fillText(e.icon,e.x,e.y);ctx.restore()
  });

  items.forEach(it=>drawItem(it,ts));

  // 보스 대형화 + 오라
  if(boss){
   ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
   ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,220,90,${.45+.2*Math.sin(ts*.007)})`;ctx.lineWidth=5;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+10+Math.sin(ts*.005)*5,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#9eeaff88';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+22,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.restore();

   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   if(finalForm){
    // 2형태 실루엣: 검붉은 날개/뿔 + 다중 오라 + 번쩍이는 핵
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(boss.x,boss.y);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(70,0,30,.72)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-28,-22);ctx.lineTo(-94,-70);ctx.lineTo(-72,6);ctx.lineTo(-112,34);ctx.lineTo(-42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(28,-22);ctx.lineTo(94,-70);ctx.lineTo(72,6);ctx.lineTo(112,34);ctx.lineTo(42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ff315d';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,boss.r+34+Math.sin(ts*.009)*7,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
   }
   drawEmoji(boss.icon,boss.x,boss.y,(92+stageNo*9)*(finalForm?1.28:1));
   if(finalForm){
    ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a6';ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=16;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y+8,7+Math.sin(ts*.013)*2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle=finalForm?'#ffb3c3':'#fff';ctx.font=`1000 ${finalForm?14:12}px sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.fillText(boss.name,boss.x,boss.y+boss.r+34)
  }

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=b.color;ctx.shadowColor=b.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()
  });

  // OPTION 분신 최대 5개
  const clones=clonePositions();
  clones.forEach((c,i)=>{
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.35+.07*(i%2);ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#cf83ff';ctx.shadowBlur=11;
    isKf21?ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-25,-25,50,50):ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-20,-21,40,42);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',c.x,c.y,30);
    ctx.restore()
   }
  });

  if(player.inv<=0||Math.floor(ts/80)%2===0){
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#8cf3ff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    isKf21?ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-40,-40,80,80):ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-30,-31,60,62);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',player.x,player.y,48)
   }
  }

  drawEffects(dt);
  drawSuper(ts);
  ctx.restore();

  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

 stageBegin(1);
 updateHud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();
  superBtn.onclick=null;stopBGM()
 }
}

  {from:40000,  to:88000,  curve:.00480,  label:'초급격 장거리 우커브'},
  {from:88000,  to:130000, curve:0,       label:'진주성 직선'},
  {from:130000, to:182000, curve:-.00540, label:'초급격 성벽 좌커브'},
  {from:182000, to:220000, curve:0,       label:'남강 진입 직선'},
  {from:220000, to:274000, curve:.00470,  label:'남강 초급격 우커브'},
  {from:274000, to:315000, curve:0,       label:'강변 직선'},
  {from:315000, to:365000, curve:-.00520, label:'도심 초급격 좌커브'},
  {from:365000, to:392000, curve:.00420,  label:'피니시 급 우스위퍼'},
  {from:392000, to:420000, curve:0,       label:'피니시 스트레이트'}
 ];

 function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
 function sectionIndex(){return clamp(Math.floor(distance/(FINISH/5)),0,4)}
 function resize(){
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  W=Math.max(300,Math.floor(r.width||sr.width||window.innerWidth||360));
  H=Math.max(420,Math.floor(r.height||sr.height||(window.innerHeight-62)||560));
  DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  canvas.width=Math.floor(W*DPR);canvas.height=Math.floor(H*DPR);ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0)
 }
 resize();
 let ro=null;
 try{if(window.ResizeObserver){ro=new ResizeObserver(resize);ro.observe(wrap)}else window.addEventListener('resize',resize)}catch(e){}

 function banner(a,b){
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='raceBanner';e.innerHTML=`<b>${a}</b><span>${b}</span>`;
  wrap.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.classList.add('hide'),850);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),1450)
 }
 function courseSegment(d){for(const c of COURSE)if(d>=c.from&&d<c.to)return c;return COURSE[COURSE.length-1]}
 function curveAt(d){
  const c=courseSegment(d),span=c.to-c.from,edge=Math.min(280,span*.10);
  if(!c.curve)return 0;
  let f=1;
  if(d<c.from+edge){const t=clamp((d-c.from)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  else if(d>c.to-edge){const t=clamp((c.to-d)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  return c.curve*f
 }
 function visualRateNow(){
  const r=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1);
  const boostPart=clamp((speed-NORMAL_MAX)/(BOOST_MAX-NORMAL_MAX),0,1);
  return 7+35*r*r+8*boostPart
 }
 function cornerState(){
  const c=curveAt(distance+WORLD_PER_SEG*18),strength=clamp(Math.abs(c)/.00540,0,1);
  const sr=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1.18);
  const load=clamp(strength*sr*sr,0,1.35);
  const safeSpeed=215-strength*30;
  const excess=Math.max(0,speed-safeSpeed);
  return {curve:c,strength,load,safeSpeed,excess}
 }

 /* 커브의 방향각과 횡위치를 계속 누적하고 far 쪽 이동을 지우지 않는다.
    강한 커브에서는 화면 전체 도로가 하나의 큰 아크를 만든다. */
 function buildRoadPoints(){
  const pts=[],hz=Math.round(H*.285);
  let heading=0,lateral=0;
  const speedFov=1+clamp(speed/BOOST_MAX,0,1)*.22;
  for(let rel=1;rel<=DRAW;rel++){
   const d=distance+rel*WORLD_PER_SEG,c=curveAt(d);
   heading+=c*1.15;lateral+=heading;
   const q=clamp(1-rel/DRAW,0,1),p=q*q,y=hz+p*(H-hz),width=16+p*W*1.07*speedFov;
   const curveShift=Math.tanh(lateral*.033)*W*.48;
   const center=W*.5+curveShift-playerX*width*.27;
   pts.push({rel,d,q,p,y,width,center,curve:c,heading,lateral})
  }
  return pts
 }
 function pointAtRel(rel,pts){return pts[clamp(Math.round(rel)-1,0,pts.length-1)]}
 function updateHud(){
  const si=sectionIndex()
--- 2 @ 1354218 ---
   ctx.fillText(e.icon,e.x,e.y);ctx.restore()
  });

  items.forEach(it=>drawItem(it,ts));

  // 보스 대형화 + 오라
  if(boss){
   ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
   ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,220,90,${.45+.2*Math.sin(ts*.007)})`;ctx.lineWidth=5;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+10+Math.sin(ts*.005)*5,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#9eeaff88';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+22,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.restore();

   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   if(finalForm){
    // 2형태 실루엣: 검붉은 날개/뿔 + 다중 오라 + 번쩍이는 핵
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(boss.x,boss.y);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(70,0,30,.72)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-28,-22);ctx.lineTo(-94,-70);ctx.lineTo(-72,6);ctx.lineTo(-112,34);ctx.lineTo(-42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(28,-22);ctx.lineTo(94,-70);ctx.lineTo(72,6);ctx.lineTo(112,34);ctx.lineTo(42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ff315d';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,boss.r+34+Math.sin(ts*.009)*7,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
   }
   drawEmoji(boss.icon,boss.x,boss.y,(92+stageNo*9)*(finalForm?1.28:1));
   if(finalForm){
    ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a6';ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=16;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y+8,7+Math.sin(ts*.013)*2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle=finalForm?'#ffb3c3':'#fff';ctx.font=`1000 ${finalForm?14:12}px sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.fillText(boss.name,boss.x,boss.y+boss.r+34)
  }

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=b.color;ctx.shadowColor=b.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()
  });

  // OPTION 분신 최대 5개
  const clones=clonePositions();
  clones.forEach((c,i)=>{
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.35+.07*(i%2);ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#cf83ff';ctx.shadowBlur=11;
    isKf21?ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-25,-25,50,50):ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-20,-21,40,42);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',c.x,c.y,30);
    ctx.restore()
   }
  });

  if(player.inv<=0||Math.floor(ts/80)%2===0){
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#8cf3ff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    isKf21?ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-40,-40,80,80):ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-30,-31,60,62);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',player.x,player.y,48)
   }
  }

  drawEffects(dt);
  drawSuper(ts);
  ctx.restore();

  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

 stageBegin(1);
 updateHud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();
  superBtn.onclick=null;stopBGM()
 }
}

 function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
 function sectionIndex(){return clamp(Math.floor(distance/(FINISH/5)),0,4)}

 function banner(a,b){
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='raceBanner';e.innerHTML=`<b>${a}</b><span>${b}</span>`;
  wrap.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.classList.add('hide'),850);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),1450)
 }
 function courseSegment(d){for(const c of COURSE)if(d>=c.from&&d<c.to)return c;return COURSE[COURSE.length-1]}
 function curveAt(d){
  const c=courseSegment(d),span=c.to-c.from,edge=Math.min(280,span*.10);
  if(!c.curve)return 0;
  let f=1;
  if(d<c.from+edge){const t=clamp((d-c.from)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  else if(d>c.to-edge){const t=clamp((c.to-d)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  return c.curve*f
 }
 function visualRateNow(){
  const r=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1);
  const boostPart=clamp((speed-NORMAL_MAX)/(BOOST_MAX-NORMAL_MAX),0,1);
  return 7+35*r*r+8*boostPart
 }
 function cornerState(){
  const c=curveAt(distance+WORLD_PER_SEG*18),strength=clamp(Math.abs(c)/.00540,0,1);
  const sr=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1.18);
  const load=clamp(strength*sr*sr,0,1.35);
  const safeSpeed=215-strength*30;
  const excess=Math.max(0,speed-safeSpeed);
  return {curve:c,strength,load,safeSpeed,excess}
 }

 /* 커브의 방향각과 횡위치를 계속 누적하고 far 쪽 이동을 지우지 않는다.
    강한 커브에서는 화면 전체 도로가 하나의 큰 아크를 만든다. */
 function buildRoadPoints(){
  const pts=[],hz=Math.round(H*.285);
  let heading=0,lateral=0;
  const speedFov=1+clamp(speed/BOOST_MAX,0,1)*.22;
  for(let rel=1;rel<=DRAW;rel++){
   const d=distance+rel*WORLD_PER_SEG,c=curveAt(d);
   heading+=c*1.15;lateral+=heading;
   const q=clamp(1-rel/DRAW,0,1),p=q*q,y=hz+p*(H-hz),width=16+p*W*1.07*speedFov;
   const curveShift=Math.tanh(lateral*.033)*W*.48;
   const center=W*.5+curveShift-playerX*width*.27;
   pts.push({rel,d,q,p,y,width,center,curve:c,heading,lateral})
  }
  return pts
 }
 function pointAtRel(rel,pts){return pts[clamp(Math.round(rel)-1,0,pts.length-1)]}

  $('#raceSpeedNum').textContent=Math.floor(speed);$('#raceCoin').textContent='🪙 '+raceCoinCount;
  needle.style.transform=`translateX(-50%) rotate(${-125+clamp(s

    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(28,-22);ctx.lineTo(94,-70);ctx.lineTo(72,6);ctx.lineTo(112,34);ctx.lineTo(42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,boss.r+34+Math.sin(ts*.009)*7,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();

   drawEmoji(boss.icon,boss.x,boss.y,(92+stageNo*9)*(finalForm?1.28:1));
   if(finalForm){
    ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a6';ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=16;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y+8,7+Math.sin(ts*.013)*2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle=finalForm?'#ffb3c3':'#fff';ctx.font=`1000 ${finalForm?14:12}px sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.fillText(boss.name,boss.x,boss.y+boss.r+34)

   }else{
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',player.x,player.y,48)
   }
  }

  drawEffects(dt);
  drawSuper(ts);
  ctx.restore();

  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

 }

    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y+8,7+Math.sin(ts*.013)*2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle=finalForm?'#ffb3c3':'#fff';ctx.font=`1000 ${finalForm?14:12}px sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.fillText(boss.name,boss.x,boss.y+boss.r+34)
  }

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=b.color;ctx.shadowColor=b.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()
  });

  // OPTION 분신 최대 5개
  const clones=clonePositions();
  clones.forEach((c,i)=>{
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.35+.07*(i%2);ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#cf83ff';ctx.shadowBlur=11;
    isKf21?ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-25,-25,50,50):ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-20,-21,40,42);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',c.x,c.y,30);
    ctx.restore()
   }
  });

  if(player.inv<=0||Math.floor(ts/80)%2===0){
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#8cf3ff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    isKf21?ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-40,-40,80,80):ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-30,-31,60,62);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',player.x,player.y,48)
   }
  }

  drawEffects(dt);
  drawSuper(ts);
  ctx.restore();

  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

 stageBegin(1);
 updateHud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();
  superBtn.onclick=null;stopBGM()
 }
}
